sources.title: GitHub - incrediblecrab/llmmm: Ingredient embedding models evaluated ...
sources.snippet: llmmm trains ingredient predictors and recipe-ranking models. Our released model, llmmm-recipes, has its own weights and biases trained from scratch on canonical recipe ingredient sets. No pretrained model was used to initialize it.
